booking.source: recreation.gov catalog (sites 3-10, 12, 13, 23, 25 Site-Specific reservable; 24, 26, 27, 28 not reservable; 1, 2, 14-22 not listed) and rules (minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14); FS page ('Some sites can be reserved ... fees.source: FS page ('Single Site: $30 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $6 per vehicle per night'); recreation.gov rates $30 every site type 2026-2028; notice 'Site fee includes one RV with tow vehicle, tent sites include two vehicles. If space allows a third vehicle would be an additional fee'

sites.source: FS page ('White Ledge campground has 28 sites') and site map (two loops, 1-28, host 11); recreation.gov catalog: STANDARD NONELECTRIC RV/Trailer 35 ft sites 3, 27; 30 ft 10, 25; 25 ft 4, 5, 23, 26, 28 (and host 11); 20 ft 24 - nine public sites take 23 ft+ (3, 4, 5, 10, 23, 25 reservable; 26, 27, 28 first-come); every typed driveway Back-In gravel. Squares 2 and 17 on the FS map are not catalogued (length unknown).

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'); recreation.gov ('Accessible restrooms and a hand pump for drinking water are provided. There are no showers or dump station on-site')

values.note: Mid-May to mid-October; recreation.gov sells 2027 nights May 20 to October 11.

season.source: FS page (Seasons of Use 'Mid-May to Mid-October'); recreation.gov rates ('Peak Season 2027-05-20 to 2027-10-11')

discounts.source: FS page ('Senior and Access pass holders receive a 50% discount')

note: On the west side of NH-16 about 5 miles south of Conway, in white pine and hardwoods at the foot of Mt. Chocorua; road noise can carry. Two loops and a grassy play area. The White Ledge Trail (4-mile loop) and the Carter Ledge Trail to the Chocorua summit leave from the campground. Two pets per site. --Claude
summary: FS page + site map + rec.gov 232172: 28 sites on two loops, nine public RV spurs take 25-35 ft (six reservable), $30 + $6 extra vehicle, vault toilets and hand-pump water, no showers or dump, mid-May to mid-October, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums. Not waterfront (no water near). max_rig_ft added (35).
flags: PHONE: 877-444-6777 (recreation.gov call centre) -> 802-289-0970 (recreation.gov: 'For facility specific information, please call (802) 289-0970', the concessionaire). recreation.gov's facility phone field shows 603-447-5448 (Saco RD).

PIN: stored 43.95332,-71.21345 sits on NH-16 at the entrance (FS lat/long 43.95436,-71.21389 is ~120 m north-west); the loops lie north-west of the highway under canopy and cannot be picked out on Esri, so no move proposed. recreation.gov's per-site coordinates are wrong (they plot ~1.8 km south-west, on houses at a hamlet beside the highway) - do not use them.
Not waterfront confirmed: no water body near the loops on imagery or either map.
sites.max_rig_ft added: 35 (sites 3, 27). Site 24 (20 ft) does not fit a 23-ft rig.
